headline: Philippine Stock Exchange index falls to lowest level in over six years
summary: The benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) plunged to its lowest closing level in more than six years amid widespread market risk aversion and capital outflows.
why: The Philippine Stock Exchange Index tracks major listed companies in the Philippines, serving as a primary indicator of market sentiment.

impacts.name: PSEi
impacts.why: Negative investor sentiment dragged the national index to its lowest level since 2020.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Market-wide selling pushed the benchmark equity index to a six-year low.
